claims.excerpt: GRACE Follow-On investigates changes in Earth’s water by measuring the distance between two satellites.
claims.claim: GRACE Follow-On uses the distance between its satellites to investigate changes in Earth’s water.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: The changing inter-satellite distance is a raw measurement used to infer shifts in mass. The mission follows changes involving groundwater, lakes and rivers, soil moisture, glaciers, ice sheets and changes in sea level attributable to water added to the oceans.
claims.narrative: Explain how GRACE Follow-On’s two satellites use changes in the distance between them to help investigate water movement on Earth.
claims.explanation: The source links changing satellite separation to inferred mass shifts and describes the mission as following changes in water stores and sea level.
claims.materiality: Core description of the mission’s measurement and purpose; accurate.
